messages.text: Hello! You've reached FixIt Phone Repair. How can I help?
I dropped my phone and the screen is cracked. It still turns on, though. How much is a repair?
For your model, a new screen is $129, which includes a 90-day warranty. Most repairs take about an hour.
We have openings at 2 and 4 P.M. Before you come, please back up your photos and files, just in case. We have never lost anyone's data, but it's always safer.
I'll take 4. I have class until 3.
Booked! Bring your phone charger too, since we test the battery after every repair.

options: A. His phone will not turn on.
B. His phone's battery is dead.
C. He lost his photos and files.
D. His phone's screen is damaged.
questions.explanation: He writes, "the screen is cracked. It still turns on, though."

questions.stem: At 11:25 A.M., why does Mr. Park write, "I have class until 3"?
options: A. To explain why he cannot come at 2 P.M.
B. To ask for a student discount
C. To say he will be late for his appointment
D. To request a repair that takes less than an hour
questions.explanation: The openings are at 2 and 4 P.M.; being in class until 3 means the 2 P.M. slot does not work for him.

questions.stem: What is Mr. Park asked to bring?
options: A. A copy of his receipt
questions.explanation: Sofia says, "Bring your phone charger too, since we test the battery after every repair."
